text:
Type: round braided cord rug
Use: brightening a play or reading corner; children's room, playroom, bedroom
Style: contemporary, retro
Materials: thick braided cord coiled and stitched in a spiral
Colors: bright orange, lemon yellow center
Shape: flat circle of tightly coiled braided cord, contrasting yellow center disc, spiral texture, small, light visual weight
Feel: playful, cheerful, warm, bold
Goes with: white walls, light wood, orange or yellow accents; cheerful kids' rooms and playrooms

product.name: STICKAT
product.description: You can turn the rug over and use it longer, as it looks the same on both sides.
